user_turns: I am new to this app. I have only this completed schedule and do not remember all our rules. Help me prepare next month from this example without making me recall everything from scratch. D, E and N mean day, evening and night. I have no original YAML or rule sheet. Focus on possible rest limits and whether nurses are restricted to particular shift types. Do not discuss staffing counts, build YAML or optimize yet. Reply as JSON with suggestedRules (a nonempty list of strings, each giving a short suggestion and its supporting observation), confirmationQuestion (one question about the suggested rules), and confirmedRules (null until I confirm).

The observed short work stretches and single-shift assignments are just examples. Our actual policy allows at most five consecutive working days. Everyone can work D, E and N. Create YAML for December 1-6, 2026 with P1, P2 and P3. Forbid six consecutive working days using a WORKING shift group containing D, E and N and a hard succession rule. Do not impose a two-day limit or separate eligibility pools. Keep the required one-shift-per-day rule. Do not add staffing, requests, fairness or other preferences. Leave history empty because the workbook is from early November and does not reach the day before this new range. Do not import a holiday calendar or copy old assignments as requests. No optimization.

added.type: at most one shift per day
